root: ^Everyone keeps loudly talking over one another. You can barely hear yourself think.
^Everyone be quiet!! I am a detective and I need to investigate this, right now!
^Everyone stares directly at you. After a few moments of complete silence, they reluctantly leave the room. You breathe for a moment, trying to process everything.
^Without wasting another breath, you go into detective mode. Determined to figure out what caused this.
